When does New Year 2027 start in Russia?

Russia spans 11 different UTC offsets on New Year's Eve, so 2027 arrives in waves. The first region to celebrate is Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky (UTC+12:00) at 12:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026, and the last is Kaliningrad (UTC+02:00), 10 hours later.

The countdown above follows Moscow, where midnight falls at 21:00 UTC.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Russia in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Moscow follows 11 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 14 hours after Moscow.

When the clock strikes midnight in Moscow, 52 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC+03:30): Iran
  • Just after (UTC+02:00): Egypt, Greece, South Africa, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burundi, Cyprus, Democratic Republic of the Congo (Lubumbashi) and 20 more

Who celebrates at the same time as Russia?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC+03:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Moscow: Turkey, Bahrain, Belarus, Comoros, Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Kuwait, Madagascar and 7 more.

New Year traditions in Russia

New Year (Novy God) is the main winter holiday in Russia. Families gather around a decorated tree, Ded Moroz and Snegurochka bring presents, and at midnight people listen to the Kremlin chimes after the president's televised address.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Russia in UTC?

Midnight in Moscow corresponds to 21:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026. Other regions of Russia follow, up to 10 hours apart.

How many time zones does Russia have on New Year's Eve?

Russia uses 11 different UTC offsets on December 31, from UTC+12:00 in Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky to UTC+02:00 in Kaliningrad.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Russia on New Year's Eve?

No. Moscow keeps UTC+03:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Russia?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC+03:30, which includes Iran.
